goals.description: Read-only exploration of the target plugin, its package layout, existing old-system entry points, pages, routes, APIs, translations, and validation tooling; prepares the preload plan for all subsequent goals.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Do a read-only inspection of /workspace. Identify the plugin package root, package.json, current exports/typesVersions/dependencies, src/plugin.ts or equivalent old-system plugin file, src/index.ts exports, route ref files, API factory/ref files, translation refs, page/component files, and available validation scripts/configs. Do not modify any workspace files. Before ending this goal, call set_preload_plan exactly once with a JSON object of shape {"goals":{"G001":[...],"G002":[...],...}}. Use the complete DAG to predict each later goal's filesystem state after its transitive predecessors are merged. Map each later goal id to concise, useful text-file paths relative to /workspace that the goal should preload; include likely created destination paths such as src/alpha.tsx or src/alpha/index.ts when relevant, omit deleted paths, and do not include dependency directories, build outputs, caches, generated bundles, or control files. For G007 include implementation files, test/config files, package manifests, and any API report files needed for validation.
goals.name: Explore workspace and plan goal context

goals.description: Adds the ./alpha package subpath export, matching typesVersions entry, and required dependencies for the new frontend system while preserving the existing main entry point.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on the package manifest changes for dual entry point support. Update the plugin package.json so the existing main export remains intact and ./alpha points at the chosen alpha source file or alpha directory index. Add the matching typesVersions mapping. Add @backstage/frontend-plugin-api as a dependency, and add @backstage/ui only if the NFS page implementation will use its Header or other UI components. Prefer existing dependency conventions and ordering.
goals.name: Update package entry points and dependencies

goals.description: Updates route refs, API refs, translation/ref exports, and main entry exports so both frontend systems share refs correctly without duplicating them through the alpha entry point.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on shared refs and public exports outside the new alpha plugin implementation. Keep existing route refs usable directly; do not introduce convertLegacyRouteRef or compatWrapper for route migration. Add sensible defaultTarget values to external route refs where common Backstage targets are clear. If API refs need NFS ownership, use the frontend-plugin-api createApiRef builder with explicit pluginId where appropriate and in the package where refs are owned. Ensure translation refs, API refs, and route refs remain exported from the main entry point or react package, and avoid duplicating these ref exports from ./alpha.
goals.name: Align shared refs and public exports

goals.description: Adds new-system page components that preserve old-system pages while removing old page shells from NFS render paths and forwarding customization props.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on component files for pages and tabbed sub-pages. Preserve old exported page components and their Page/PageWithHeader legacy shell. Add NFS variants or a headerVariant split so the new-system render path contains content only and does not render Page, PageWithHeader, or an old ContentHeader shell. Use Header from @backstage/ui only for subtitle/custom actions below the framework header, moving old ContentHeader actions to Header customActions when needed. Forward the same customization props accepted by the old page. For SubPageBlueprint targets, expose content-only sub-page components suitable for tab rendering. If NFS code uses frontend-plugin-api useRouteRef for external routes, handle undefined.
goals.name: Implement NFS page and sub-page variants

goals.description: Creates new-system ApiBlueprint extensions for APIs previously registered on the old createPlugin while preserving the old-system API registration.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on API extension implementation for the alpha/new frontend system. Locate APIs currently supplied through createPlugin({ apis: [...] }) or similar old-system mechanisms and create ApiBlueprint.make extensions using @backstage/frontend-plugin-api dependency refs. Preserve old-system API registrations. Keep factories semantically equivalent, use the shared API refs adjusted by the refs goal, and place the new API extensions where the alpha plugin can import them without entangling old-system entry points.
goals.name: Convert plugin API factories to ApiBlueprint extensions

goals.description: Adds the new ./alpha entry point using createFrontendPlugin, PageBlueprint and optional SubPageBlueprints, wires routes, pages, API extensions, icon/title, and alpha component exports.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on creating or updating the alpha entry point chosen by the package manifest, such as src/alpha.tsx or src/alpha/index.ts plus adjacent alpha files. Export a default createFrontendPlugin configured with the correct pluginId, title, icon, extensions, routes, and externalRoutes. Create PageBlueprint entries for top-level pages and SubPageBlueprint entries for tabbed sub-pages where applicable; if using sub-pages, omit the parent PageBlueprint loader so the framework renders tabs. Load the NFS page variants from component files. Add ApiBlueprint extensions to the plugin extensions array. Re-export NFS page variants from ./alpha under the same public component names only when adopters need customization via overrides; do not re-export shared refs that belong in the main entry point.
goals.name: Create alpha frontend plugin entry

goals.description: Derives acceptance criteria and exact validation commands or scripts for checking dual old/new frontend support without performing the final validation run.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Prepare, but do not execute, the validation plan. Use the workspace context and package scripts/configs to produce a concise predecessor summary containing acceptance criteria and exact commands for type checking, linting, old-system compatibility, new-system compatibility, and API report updates if the project uses them. Prefer existing commands such as yarn tsc, yarn lint, app-specific checks for packages/app-legacy and packages/app when present, and yarn build:api-reports when configured. If you create any helper validation script, write it to an isolated non-source path and record its path. Do not redesign implementation.
goals.name: Prepare validation plan

goals.description: Executes the prepared checks after implementation, repairs type/lint/API-report issues, and confirms old and new frontend system support remain intact.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Run the validation plan prepared by G006 and reuse its acceptance criteria and commands; adapt only when actual results or the workspace require changes. Validate that the old plugin entry point still works, the ./alpha entry point compiles, package exports/typesVersions resolve, NFS pages avoid legacy page shells, route refs and external route defaults are correct, APIBlueprint extensions are wired, and shared refs remain exported from the main entry point. Fix any type, lint, dependency, import, or API report issues found, updating API reports if the project uses them.
goals.name: Run validation and fix integration issues
